d: Is Teachers Day, Chef Sanjeev Kapoor ke saath seekhiye kuch simple aur useful cooking basics. Is special cooking class mein hum banayenge everyday meals ko easy aur perfect banane ke simple tareeke. Rice ko perfectly cook karne se lekar dal, phulka aur sabzi tak, har recipe ke saath milenge useful cooking tips. Agar aap beginner hain ya basic cooking skills improve karna chahte hain, toh ye video aapke liye perfect hai. Toh is Teachers Day kitchen mein lagaiye apni class aur Chef Sanjeev Kapoor ke saath seekhiye, banaiye aur enjoy kijiye delicious ghar ka khana.
